name: Sakura Nova ~Kishi Gakuen Monogatari~
original_name: サクラ･ノヴァ ～騎士学園物語～
source:
In Sakura Nova, join Mikage, Kaguya, and Arisa as they train together and experience life together in academy life. They all have done trials individually but when the sergeant told them to work together as a team all hell breaks loose! Will they ever become proper knights?

[From [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=768202390/]Steam - Greenlight[/url]]
translation:
在《樱花新星》中，你将与御影、辉夜和亚里纱一起训练，共同经历学园生活。他们各自都曾完成过考验，可当教官要求他们组队合作时，一切却乱了套！他们究竟能不能成为合格的骑士？

（来源：[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=768202390/]Steam青睐之光[/url]）
